sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: UI UX Pro Max is a design skill for AI coding assistants. When you ask your agent to build an interface, it searches a built-in library of styles, colour palettes, font pairings and UX rules and generates a design system for your kind of product.
sixtySeconds.problem: AI agents often produce generic-looking interfaces with weak accessibility. This skill gives the agent design knowledge, such as which style and colours fit a spa versus a fintech app, plus a checklist for contrast, focus states and responsive layouts.
whoFor: Developers who build UIs with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar
Founders building landing pages and dashboards with AI
Designers who want consistent AI-generated UI
Teams using many different frontend stacks
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want better-looking, more accessible UI from your agent without writing design rules yourself. A paid premium version adds brand, logo and asset work.
requirements: Python 3.x for the search script (standard library only)
Node.js and npm for the uipro CLI

overview: The skill bundles 80 searchable UI styles, 194 colour palettes matched to 194 product types, 74 font pairings, 25 chart types and 141 UX guidelines, with stack-specific advice for 22 frameworks including React, Next.js, Vue, SwiftUI, Flutter and shadcn/ui.

Its Design System Generator reads your request, for example a landing page for a beauty spa, and recommends a page pattern, style, colours, typography, effects, anti-patterns to avoid and a pre-delivery checklist. It uses a BM25 search engine over its data; the scripts install nothing and make no network calls.
In most assistants the skill activates on its own when you ask for UI work. In Kiro, Roo Code and KiloCode you call it with /ui-ux-pro-max. The uipro CLI installs it for more than 20 assistants.

troubleshooting.solution: Your CLI is outdated. Run npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli@latest and retry.

troubleshooting.problem: Claude Code says the response exceeded the output token maximum
troubleshooting.solution: Ask Claude to split the task and write large results to files, or raise CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS before starting a new session.
Install Python 3 from python.org or your OS package manager.
